item.title: Simple Sprout Shop Logo

turns.text: Make a square logo for my plant shop, Little Sprout. Just a simple green sprout above the name on white, nothing fancy.

item.tests: Produces a usable simple logo combining a clear mark and a readable business name.

answer_sheet.Mark and style: A simple green sprout above the name; clean and unfussy.

must_haves: A recognizable, simple green sprout sits above the name.
The square image contains a flat logo, not a photograph or merchandise mockup.

turns.text: make a logo for my plant shop

dialog.agent:
I'd be glad to make a logo for your plant shop. First, one quick question:

Where will this be shown or posted (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, a website, print, somewhere else)?
dialog.why: The assistant asks where the logo will be shown and waits for the user's answer before making anything.
dialog.user: idk, just want it square on white

turns.agent:
I couldn't make the logo. Magic Hour turned the request down because your account doesn't have enough credits, so no image was made and you weren't charged.

I'd already used one of the cheapest options: the flux-2-klein model at 640px, which costs about 5 credits per image. I don't have a smaller setting to try.

**To go ahead,** add credits in your Magic Hour account or wait for your free credits to refresh, then tell me and I'll run it again. The logo will be square on a plain white background, with a flat green plant in a small pot.

Should the logo include your shop's name or a slogan? If so, send me the exact words. If not, I'll make it as a symbol with no text.
